_about: Captured from one run's suite-writing stage (a page product set up by a custom setup). The project directory is renamed `list-app`; every other string is as captured.
timeout_error: Command timed out after 300 seconds. A command that does not finish is usually one that was not meant to: a server, a watcher, or something waiting on input that will never come. This project has a browser runner installed and browsers do run here, so the likely causes are different: the whole suite run at once against this limit, or a `webServer` that never came up. Run a smaller part of it - one project (`--project=...`), one spec file, or `--reporter=line` - and check the server command separately. Do not replace the browser test with a hand-written `global.document`: that is refused elsewhere, and for good reason.
